purpose: Ten licensed art images for the second-screen inspiration gallery; recommended order is 01–05 in the first row and 06–10 in the second row.
source_policy: All ten source pages explicitly identify these images as free under the standard Unsplash License. Unsplash+ assets were excluded. These are downloaded creator works, not generated for this task.

license.name: Unsplash License
license.restrictions_summary: Do not sell essentially unmodified images or compile them into a competing image service. The license does not transfer authorship. Use them as licensed visual inspiration, not as claims of the site owner’s original client work.

processing: Downloaded 2000px-wide JPEG versions from the image URLs linked by each source page. Center/subject-aware crop to 1.55:1 and Lanczos resize to 1240×800. No generative edits, text overlays, color changes, watermarks removed, or content additions. WebP quality 90, reduced only if the file would exceed 300 KB.
